summary: Western Midstream Partners, LP filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Brazos Delaware II, LLC from Brazos Permian II, LLC for approximately $1.6 billion. Consideration consisted of $800 million in cash and 19,389,239 common units (worth ~$800 million based on a 20-day VWAP at signing). The board had previously approved the deal. Seller received registration rights and is subject to a six-month lock-up. The acquisition adds midstream assets in the Permian Basin. Key risk-arb factors include post-close unit price performance relative to the lock-up expiration and any integration issues.
